questions.q: Which quality does Hewlett's research place at the core of executive presence?
a: Gravitas
Appearance
Networking
Credentials
questions.why: Lesson 1 says over half the leaders surveyed named gravitas.

questions.q: How did Bob Dudley show gravitas during the BP oil spill?
a: He stayed patient and answered every question
He avoided the press entirely
He blamed contractors in public
He resigned within a few weeks
questions.why: Lesson 1 says his composure helped him become CEO months later.

questions.q: What did Suzi Digby say about first impressions?
a: You have about five seconds to engage an audience
You need a full minute to connect
First impressions rarely affect careers
Appearance matters more than speech
questions.why: Lesson 2 cites her five-second slot for engaging people.

questions.q: What is the best way to improve your communication, per the summary?
a: Ask for specific feedback on things like body language
Record yourself and judge your own delivery
Read several books on public speaking
Copy the style of a leader you admire
questions.why: Lesson 2 recommends detailed questions over a vague how did I do.

questions.q: Why does physical fitness help a leader, according to Deb Elam?
a: People assume you can handle whatever you are given
It makes you appear friendlier to strangers
It proves you work long hours
It distracts from weak qualifications
questions.why: Lesson 3 says fitness signals you take care of yourself and other matters.
